name: Large-scale migration
description: Locate every reference to the legacy API so Map workers can rewrite bounded shards.

selectors.description: Replace legacy-package with the real package name being migrated
Replace LegacyClient with the real symbol

mapGuidance: Rewrite this shard from the legacy API to the target API. Keep changes minimal. Run the tightest local tests you can. Report residual refs and blockers. Structured result: files_changed, residual_refs, test_status, blockers.
reduceGuidance: Merge leftover refs. Detect duplicate helpers created by parallel workers. Order PRs so shared libs land before apps.
verifyGuidance: CI green for touched packages; smoke the migrated flows.
